cards.description:
The Cognitive Abilities Test (CAT4) helps us understand how students learn and their academic potential. Students in Grades 3–9 take this assessment upon enrollment to identify their learning styles, enabling teachers to:

•	Adapt teaching approaches and materials
•	Adjust instructional pace and emphasis
•	Implement differentiated instruction

CAT4 measures four types of reasoning:

•	Verbal Reasoning - Understanding and reasoning through words
•	Quantitative Reasoning - Using numerical skills for problem-solving
•	Non-verbal Reasoning - Problem-solving using visual information
•	Spatial Ability - Thinking and drawing conclusions in three dimensions
cards.title: CAT4 Assessment

cards.description:
Students in Grades 3–9 participate in MAP testing three times throughout the academic year. These computer-adaptive assessments:

•	Produce accurate data about each student’s learning level
•	Identify areas of strength and opportunity
•	Measure overall performance in core subjects
cards.title: NWEA MAP Testing

cards.description: To benchmark Arabic language proficiency against international standards, our students participate in IBT Arabic examinations conducted by ACER. This assessment provides valuable comparative data on student performance relative to peers in the region and worldwide.
cards.title: IBT Arabic Testing

cards.description:
The New Group Reading Test (NGRT) measures reading skills against national averages. This standardized assessment evaluates:

•	Phonics knowledge
•	Reading comprehension
•	Decoding ability
•	Vocabulary development
•	Grammatical understanding
•	Deduction and inference skills
•	Understanding of figurative and idiomatic language
cards.title: NGRT Testing

children.text: In Early Years, we focus on hands-on learning and learning through fun. Through carefully designed play-based and project-based activities, our youngest learners explore foundational concepts in a joyful environment. Daily activities integrate reading, social-emotional learning (SEL), STEM, and robotics, nurturing curiosity and creativity from an early age.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi kindergarten students playing tambourines in music class

children.text: The Early Years curriculum provides hands-on, inquiry-based learning through thematic units and play-based exploration. Integrated with California Common Core State Standards, the program emphasizes foundational literacy, numeracy, science, and social-emotional development.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi kindergarten student high-fiving his teacher in class

children.text: Under the policy of using the Arabic language in education and in line with the directives of ADEK and the UAE Ministry of Education, Sharjah American International School has developed a structured plan for teaching Arabic Language, Islamic Education, and Social Studies at the Kindergarten stage. This policy aims to strengthen early language, social, and religious skills through age-appropriate learning experiences, promote national identity and a sense of belonging, ensure equal access to learning the official language of the country, and support cultural understanding and inclusion within the diverse community of the UAE.

children.text: High School Pathways function like college majors, but begin during the high school experience. Every student can benefit from selecting and following a sequence of career-related classes aligned with their interests.
A Pathway:
Provides a sequence of courses within your area of interest
Connects your career interests from high school to college and/or career
Serves as an educational roadmap guiding you to relevant high school courses and postsecondary options
Helps you acquire knowledge and skills linked to specific postsecondary programs leading to certificates, degrees, and careers

cards.description:

Participants apply essential math and science content in real-world contexts. Career possibilities range from science and math educators to laboratory technicians to NASA astronauts.

They learn to formulate and interpret financial information for decision-making, compliance, and risk management.

Career opportunities include entrepreneurship, sales, marketing, economics, management, accounting, banking, securities and investments, and other financial specializations.

children.text: Our state-of-the-art facilities were created with our students’ best interests in mind; we took into account students’ academic and extracurricular needs and created a safe and welcoming learning environment for all students.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students in the library

children.text:
Our school is divided into separate sections for our KG Department, Elementary Department, Middle and High School Boys Section, and Middle and High School Girls Section.

In the KG Department, students have homeroom classes and their own music room, literacy room, and STEAM room, which classes use on a daily rotational basis. In the Elementary Department, students have homeroom classes as well as a dedicated literacy room, a STEAM room, and an art room.

image.alt: SAIS students and staff meeting in a modern campus learning space

children.text: In our Middle and High School Boys and Girls Sections, students have subject and homeroom classrooms. We also have a large secondary library where students can conduct research and check out reading material. Students also benefit from an Islamic room, a French room, an art room, a music room, and Arabic language rooms.

Taking into account the extended extracurricular activities that we offer our students here at SAIS - Abu Dhabi, our facilities are a highlight for many of our students. We have separate indoor gyms for girls and boys for physical education classes.
Our campus also offers volleyball courts, basketball courts, soccer fields, and two swimming pools.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi girls playing basketball on the school court

children.text: Our classrooms are purposefully designed to provide a structured, inclusive, and stimulating learning environment that supports both academic achievement and student wellbeing. Each student is provided with an individual desk, and seating arrangements are carefully organized to promote attentiveness, comfort, and positive engagement in learning.

Classrooms are fully equipped with the resources and technology necessary to support diverse learning needs and ensure that students can access information through a range of approaches, including verbal instruction, written materials, listening activities, and interactive experiences. Facilities include interactive screens, whiteboards, student lockers, and well-organized learning spaces. In addition, desks are arranged to facilitate collaborative group work, fostering teamwork, communication, and active participation as essential components of the learning process.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi teacher guiding students at their desks

children.text: Our school library is a vibrant, multi-purpose space at the heart of student learning and creativity. It features a carefully curated collection of diverse books, selected to inspire a love of reading across all age groups and support academic growth in every subject area.

Equipped with a dedicated research computer center, the library also serves as a hub for inquiry-based learning and digital exploration. Beyond books and research, the space hosts a variety of engaging activities from reading events and storytelling sessions to workshops, meetings, and school assemblies.

Adding to its dynamic role, the library also houses the school’s radio station corner, where students develop their communication skills and broadcast school news and announcements. Whether for quiet study, collaborative projects, or creative events, our library is a welcoming and essential part of the school community.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students reading together in the library

children.text: Our Makerspace is a dynamic innovation hub where students develop creativity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills through hands-on, project-based learning (PBL). It provides an inspiring environment in which students can plan, sketch, prototype, program, and create while transforming their ideas into practical solutions.

Equipped with a wide range of advanced tools and technologies, including laser cutters, wood-cutting machines, 3D printers, LEGO® Education SPIKE™ Prime kits, WhaleBot robotics tools, and other STEAM resources, the Makerspace enables students to actively engage in Design and Technology, STEAM, robotics, engineering, programming, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) through meaningful and innovative learning experiences.

Through experimentation, design challenges, coding activities, and collaborative projects, students strengthen their creativity, technical knowledge, and innovation skills while preparing for the opportunities and challenges of a rapidly evolving world.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students working in the Makerspace

children.text: Our school’s gym facilities provide students with a safe, well-equipped, and inclusive environment that promotes physical fitness, teamwork, and overall wellbeing. The school has two dedicated gym areas, one for boys and one for girls, ensuring that all students can participate in physical education and sports activities comfortably and confidently. Both gyms are equipped to support a range of activities, including football, volleyball, basketball, and padel, offering students opportunities to develop their physical skills, coordination, teamwork, and sportsmanship. These spaces are designed to encourage active lifestyles while ensuring that students learn, train, and play in a secure and well-supervised setting.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students training on the football pitch

children.text: Our swimming pool offers a safe and well-maintained environment where students develop essential swimming skills, water safety awareness, and overall fitness. Lessons are delivered by qualified and trained swimming instructors, ensuring high-quality coaching and close supervision at all times. Through structured activities, students build confidence in the water while improving technique, coordination, and overall wellbeing. The pool supports an active and healthy lifestyle within a secure and carefully monitored setting.
